description: A full featured, fast Command Line Argument Parser for Rust

latest_release.name: v4.6.7
latest_release.body:
## [4.6.7] - 2026-09-14

### Features

- *(derive)* Add `#[command(defer = <bool>)]` attribute to opt-in to lazy initialisation of subcommands

hot_issues.title: Add support for automatic negation flags
Allow adding "external argv"s to be parsed alongside/before command line
Support or document localization of messages and flags
Stablize Rust-Native Completion Engine  Tracking Issue
Partially parse args, capturing unknown args into a vec, rather than error

discussions.title: Why doesn't ValueValidation error formatting walk the error's source chain?
Non-positional mutually exclusive flags in presence of subcommands.
Machine-readable output schemas for Clap CLIs
Don't require flags if both options are provided
Is it possible to statically check a value_parser type against an argument value type?
Arg that is either an ValueEnum variant or another type (like PathBuf)

## Get Started

```console
$ cargo add clap
```

## About

Create your command-line parser, with all of the bells and whistles, declaratively or procedurally.

For more details, see:
- [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/clap/latest/clap/)
- [examples](examples/)
